name: Kamyshlinsky Waterfall
full: Kamyshlinsky Waterfall (Kamysh-La) — a two-tier waterfall on the Kamyshla River where it flows into the Katun, on the right bank of the Katun (opposite the highway) between Barangol and Ust-Sema, landmark — km 490–496 of the Chuysky Trakt
near: Barangol (the Tsarskaya Okhota (Royal Hunt) tourist base, km ~492 of the highway) and Ust-Sema (km ~496); Chemal ~40 km, Gorno-Altaysk ~60 km
elev: ≈390 m above sea level; the waterfall is 12 m high (two tiers)
short: A low (12 m) but powerful two-tier waterfall on the Kamyshla River, 2.5–3 km from the Chuysky Trakt — one of the most accessible and popular natural sites in Gorny Altai.
desc: Before flowing into the Katun, the Kamyshla River drops over two ledges with a total height of about 12 m: the upper tier is almost sheer, the lower one breaks against the rocks like a “tent”. The waterfall is a natural monument of republican significance (status since 1978, confirmed in 1996, area 0.0313 km²). It is on the right bank of the Katun, so from the Chuysky Trakt you reach it by crossing the suspension bridge of the Tsarskaya Okhota (Royal Hunt) resort complex (Barangol) or the bridge at Ust-Sema, then ~2.5–3 km along the forest “Shamans' Trail” by the Katun; in summer motorboats also run along the Katun right to its foot. At the waterfall there is a viewing platform above the upper tier and a railed boardwalk by the lower one, gazebos, souvenir stalls, a cafe, and nearby trout ponds and a rope swing. According to a claim common in guidebooks, the cascade is partly linked to a mill dam of 1930 (data from a single source — tonkosti.ru).
guide: Go through the Tsarskaya Okhota suspension bridge — the bridge over the Katun is an attraction in itself, and after it comes a pleasant 40 minutes through pine forest. Climb to the viewing platform above the upper tier: from above you can see the Kamyshla literally “fall” into the Katun. Locals say that washing your face with the waterfall's water washes away grief and tears, and a legend tells of the lovers Kamysh and La, at the place of whose death the waterfall appeared. In autumn, in golden foliage, the best shots are here; in spring after the snow melts, the stream is at its most powerful.
see: Two tiers and a viewing platform above the upper one; the boardwalk by the lower tier; the suspension bridge across the Katun at Tsarskaya Okhota; the “Shamans' Trail” through the pine forest; trout ponds (fishing with rod rental); a motorboat trip along the Katun.
skip: You have already seen Altai's big waterfalls (Uchar, Korbu, Chulcha) and dislike crowded tourist spots with paid bridges and souvenir rows — Kamyshlinsky is small and very crowded in summer.
diff: Easy: ~2.5–3 km one way along a forest trail with small climbs (≈40 min); a short steep section of 300–500 m; slippery after rain. Unofficial trails are muddy and dangerous.
when: Year-round. Spring (May–June) has the most water and the maralnik (Siberian rhododendron) in bloom; autumn (September to early October) is the most photogenic season; in winter the waterfall freezes into ice formations.
hours: A natural site with no time restrictions; the paid bridge and boats work in daylight (exact hours not found).
daytime: Morning — before the tour groups arrive (editorial data).
how: Along the Chuysky Trakt (R-256) from Gorno-Altaysk ~60 km to Barangol (km ~492) or Ust-Sema (km ~496). Option 1: the Tsarskaya Okhota suspension bridge (paid) → ~2.5–2.8 km along the trail. Option 2: the free road bridge at Ust-Sema → ~4 km along the trail by the bank. Option 3: a motorboat along the Katun to the foot. Public transport: Gorno-Altaysk — Chemal buses (06:25, 13:35, 14:05, 16:25, 18:30, from 720 ₽) pass Barangol and Ust-Sema. Note: on the Souzga — Barangol section (km 455–495) the highway is under repair in 2026.
needcar: Yes — as far as Barangol/Ust-Sema (car, Gorno-Altaysk — Chemal bus, taxi, excursion); then on foot or by boat.
self: Yes, fully: the trail is obvious, it takes 40–60 minutes to walk.
roadtype: Paved road (the Chuysky Trakt, in 2026 under repair with detours at km 455–495) to the parking area; then a forest dirt trail with roots and stones, wooden boardwalks.
traveltime: Gorno-Altaysk — Barangol ~1 h by car (60 km, longer allowing for the highway repair); the trail 40–60 min one way; by boat — a few minutes.
stay: Tsarskaya Okhota (Royal Hunt) resort complex (Barangol, Chuyskaya St. 2): an eco-house from 16,000 ₽/night, a VIP house with a pool from 18,000 ₽ (putevka.com, 2026); numerous tourist bases and guesthouses in Barangol, Ust-Sema, Manzherok, Chemal.
net: There is a mobile signal by the highway in Barangol/Ust-Sema (Wi-Fi at Tsarskaya Okhota); coverage by operator on the trail — not found.
entry: There is no separate ticket for the waterfall in recent sources; the paid crossing of the Tsarskaya Okhota suspension bridge costs 350 ₽ (Sputnik8) / 450 ₽ (2GIS), the sources differ; the route via the bridge at Ust-Sema is free. Whether the natural monument is on the list of paid protected areas of the Altai Republic (300 ₽ from 01.07.2026) — not found. There is no resort fee in the Altai Republic.
transfer: Gorno-Altaysk — Chemal bus (via Barangol) from 720 ₽; group excursions from 2850 ₽ (Manzherok) to 5200–6700 ₽ (combined from Gorno-Altaysk), individual 18,000–26,000 ₽ (Sputnik8, 2026).
bring: Closed shoes with a thick non-slip sole, a rain jacket/windbreaker (spray and wind), camera protection, tick repellent, cash for the bridge and boat.
warn: The rocks and boardwalks at the waterfall are wet and slippery; unofficial bypass trails are dangerous after rain (windfalls, steep mud). Ticks: in 2026 the Altai Republic had 3600 reports and 22 cases of encephalitis — vaccination/insurance. Repair of the Chuysky Trakt at km 455–495 in 2026 — allow extra time. Swimming in the Katun is dangerous — a strong current.
food: Trout from the local trout ponds by the waterfall; a cafe on the grounds and in Barangol (names not specified); in Chemal/Manzherok — Altai dishes (keche, talkan, kai-chai).
reviews: 2GIS: 4.7/5, 1587 ratings, 513 reviews (10.2026). Pros: beautiful, well-kept trails and viewing platforms, the bridge across the Katun, a cafe and gazebos. Cons: the paid bridge, many people, “commercialization”, dangerous unofficial trails.

p.sum: The most accessible waterfall by the Chuysky Trakt: drive to Barangol or Ust-Sema (~60 km from Gorno-Altaysk), cross the Katun by the suspension bridge (paid) or by the road bridge in Ust-Sema (free) and walk 40–60 minutes through the forest. You can go by boat. It combines well with Manzherok and Chemal.
